message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine charges based on facts. The case: defendant 曾某芬, drug addict, no income, decides to steal a motorcycle. He and accomplice 阿某 (another person) use screwdriver etc to break lock, steal motorcycle, sell it for 2000 RMB, he gets 800. Later they are caught. So the crime is theft (盗窃). Also possibly "掩饰、隐瞒犯罪所得、犯罪所得收益" because they sold the stolen motorcycle and got money. However the typical charge for selling stolen goods is "掩饰、隐瞒犯罪所得、犯罪所得收益". In previous examples, they included both theft and that charge when there was theft and then concealment. Example: second example about theft of motorcycles included "盗窃;掩饰、隐瞒犯罪所得、犯罪所得收益". That case: multiple thefts and also they concealed/handled stolen goods. In this case, they stole a motorcycle and sold it, obtaining proceeds. That likely qualifies for both theft and concealment of stolen property. The facts mention they sold the stolen motorcycle and got money. So we should include both charges.

Thus answer: 盗窃;掩饰、隐瞒犯罪所得、犯罪所得收益
